traps: requirements.txt only includes requirements/production.txt, which includes base.txt: Django and Wagtail are two files away from the root list
no file names the Python project, so the unit is referred to by its root
package.json holds only linters and formatters (eslint, stylelint, prettier): no JavaScript framework
Bootstrap is a vendored bootstrap.min.css, not a dependency
Elasticsearch, Amazon S3 and Google Cloud Storage are used only when their environment variables are set in production.py; the compose file starts PostgreSQL and Redis only
SQLite is the default database in base.py when DATABASE_URL is absent
tests run with Django's own test runner: there is no pytest
only frameworks and services are measured; the other facets are in unknown
